quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer Announces Acquisition of 200 Acres Near Rockdale (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Completed the fee simple acquisition of approximately 200 acres of greenfield land in Milam County, Texas near its existing Rockdale facility to support AI/HPC data-center development. The Milam County sites currently feature approximately 563 MW of interconnected grid capacity, with existing plans expected to scale to 742 MW, and a dedicated water supply; Bitdeer now owns and/or operates approximately 255 acres and 742 MW of existing and pipeline power capacity in Milam County and approximately 3.0 GW across its global portfolio (US, Norway, Bhutan, Canada, Malaysia, Ethiopia). CFO Michael Potter: Rockdale is well positioned to receive additional power over the coming years.
quarterly_data.figure: ~200 acres; 563 MW interconnected, scaling to 742 MW; ~3.0 GW total portfolio
